use IO.Std.write_line
use System.StringComparison

show(expression: string, result: object) =>
    write_line("{expression,-40} {result}")

let first = "Hello"
let second = "World"
let built = "{"Hel"}{"lo"}"
let shouting = "HELLO"
let ignore_case = StringComparison.ORDINAL_IGNORE_CASE

write_line("content")
show("first =~ built", first =~ built)
show("first !~ second", first !~ second)
show("first < second", first < second)
show("second > first", second > first)
show("first <> second", first <> second)

write_line("")
write_line("identity")
show("first == built", first == built)
show("first == first", first == first)

write_line("")
write_line("case")
show("shouting =~ first", shouting =~ first)
show("shouting.to_lower() =~ first.to_lower()",
    shouting.to_lower() =~ first.to_lower())
show("string.compare(shouting, first, ignore_case)",
    string.compare(shouting, first, ignore_case))

write_line("")
write_line("numeric strings compare as text")
show("\"10\" < \"9\"", "10" < "9")
show("10 < 9", 10 < 9)

use IO.Std.write_line
use System.StringComparison

show(expression: string, result: object) =>
    write_line("{expression,-40} {result}")

let first = "Hello"
let second = "World"
let built = "{"Hel"}{"lo"}"
let shouting = "HELLO"
let ignore_case = StringComparison.ORDINAL_IGNORE_CASE

write_line("content")
show("first =~ built", first =~ built)
show("first !~ second", first !~ second)
show("first < second", first < second)
show("second > first", second > first)
show("first <> second", first <> second)

write_line("")
write_line("identity")
show("first == built", first == built)
show("first == first", first == first)

write_line("")
write_line("case")
show("shouting =~ first", shouting =~ first)
show("shouting.to_lower() =~ first.to_lower()",
    shouting.to_lower() =~ first.to_lower())
show("string.compare(shouting, first, ignore_case)",
    string.compare(shouting, first, ignore_case))

write_line("")
write_line("numeric strings compare as text")
show("\"10\" < \"9\"", "10" < "9")
show("10 < 9", 10 < 9)
output:
content
first =~ built                           True
first !~ second                          True
first < second                           True
second > first                           True
first <> second                          -1

identity
first == built                           False
first == first                           True

case
shouting =~ first                        False
shouting.to_lower() =~ first.to_lower()  True
string.compare(shouting, first, ignore_case) 0

numeric strings compare as text
"10" < "9"                               True
10 < 9                                   False
